description: WHEN: a problem has just been solved, or a convention or procedure was agreed, and it should not need explaining again. Triggers: 'keep this', 'retiens ça', 'save this lesson', 'note this for next time', 'capitalise'. Propose it to the user first and save only with their agreement. Write it so a stranger could apply it: the problem as it showed up (the symptom and message), the cause, the solution step by step, and the D365 objects involved. The lesson is saved for the caller's client as UNVALIDATED; an administrator reviews it before it is trusted. Never put secrets, passwords, tokens or personal data in a lesson.

kind.description: 'lesson' (default), 'convention' (how this client does things) or 'procedure' (a repeatable how-to).

problem.description: The problem as it appeared: symptom, error message, where.

sourceRef.description: Optional: where it came from, e.g. 'WI 6587' or 'PR 142'.

title.description: Short title that says what it is about, e.g. 'Sales invoice posting fails when the tax group is empty'.

name: lesson_save
